You need two conditions on related Opportunities: one that must exist (semi-join) and one that must not (anti-join).
Semi-join: Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false). Anti-join: Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE ...).
'Won in the last 365 days' is IsWon = true AND CloseDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365. Combine both joins with AND and finish with ORDER BY Name ASC.
